title: Question 15
passage:
Do visitors need safety glasses for the mezzanine tour?
A. Yes, we'll hand them out at the front desk. B. We installed brighter lights up there last month. C. The tour starts upstairs at eleven.
passageZh:
訪客參觀夾層時需要戴護目鏡嗎？
A. 需要，我們會在服務台發給訪客。
B. 我們上個月在上面裝了更亮的燈。
C. 參觀十一點從樓上開始。
